# environment at instant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:environmentAtInstant`](gmeow-environmentAtInstant.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/environmentAtInstant>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The instant at which this point-like [`SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) holds. For interval-scoped environments, use [`gmeow:environmentDuringInterval`](gmeow-environmentDuringInterval.md) instead.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) -> [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:environmentAtInstant`](gmeow-environmentAtInstant.md) from [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) to [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
